svg.title: Concept impression: a lake-edge home at Heron Lake
svg.desc: An original illustration, not a surveyed view. Dawn light across a rocky Canadian Shield lake. Cedar and pine frame a low timber-clad home with a solar roof and a screened porch facing the water; a path leads into the forest. The landscape, home and vegetation are invented for discussion.
svg.text: Concept impression · Heron Lake · Containers Hamlet · CC BY 4.0
